blocks.text: ALBANY, N.Y. — For the second consecutive gubernatorial election, New York voters will face a general election ballot featuring only two candidates for governor, despite five political party lines. In response, the Libertarian Party of New York is calling for a statewide “None of the Above” (VOTE NOTA) write-in protest in the November 3 election, challenging both the lack of competition and the state’s restrictive ballot-access laws.

blocks.text: “New Yorkers deserve to choose a governor, not settle for whoever survives the barriers to getting on the ballot,” said Duane Whitmer, Chair of the Libertarian Party of New York. “If no one on that ballot cares about you, no one supports you, and no one deserves your vote, you should be able to say so. That’s what our NOTA campaign is about.
